title: Minimum size
slide_intent: Specify a print threshold against the letterforms people must read so the rule holds across different name lengths and lockup shapes.
strategic_value: A common cap-height limit can preserve venue names even when different lockups occupy different overall widths or heights.
demonstration: Each of the six venue marks appears in both horizontal and stacked form. Horizontal guides mark a minimum print cap height of 4 mm.
practical_value: Check letter cap height against 4 mm in the printed piece for either version of a venue mark.
